//: QA-4 — the vendored LSAT subtree is validated on its own by tsconfig.lsat.json (a strict TS project; run `npx tsc -p tsconfig.lsat.json`). The host now maps `@lsat/*` to the real subtree source (replacing the old `declare module '@lsat/*'` -> any shim), so cross-domain imports type-check end-to-end against real types. A formal `references` entry is intentionally omitted: it requires `composite`+emit, which fights this project's no-emit/Bundler (Vite) toolchain; both configs are `strict`, so host-strict-clean and tsconfig.lsat.json-clean are equivalent. See TESTING.md.
